caption:
A booking system is not a calendar. Here is what it does at 11pm.

1. Shows real availability, by venue, class or staff member.
2. Takes the booking and the payment in one go — into your Stripe account.
3. Sends the confirmation and the reminder without anyone typing it.
4. Updates the register, the schedule and the records at the same time.
5. Lets the customer change or cancel under rules you set.
6. Gives your team one screen in the morning instead of a pile of messages.

That is what The Dance Exclusive runs on across its Essex venues: 235 bookings, 139 active parents in a month, and no member of staff in the loop for a single one of them.

Free plan for yours: nullshift.co.uk/start (link in bio).

caption:
Bespoke vs template. The honest difference.

A template is someone else's guess at your business, with your logo on it. It works until your operation does something the template did not expect — a second venue, a deposit rule, a staff member who should see some things and not others.

Bespoke means we start from how you actually run: who books, who pays, who needs what screen. The software fits the business, not the other way round.

It used to mean 'expensive and slow'. With modern tooling and a senior team it means two to four weeks and a fixed quote — and you own the result.

Find out what yours would look like: nullshift.co.uk/start.

.

caption:
Why is there a monthly plan at all?

Because software does not stop needing things when it goes live.

It needs a server, a database, a domain, SSL and email that delivers. It needs backups every day and someone watching when an integration fails at 2am. It needs the fix when a payment provider changes its API. And it needs a person who knows your system when you have a question.

That is what Core, Pro and Max are. Not rent on the software — you already own that — but the running of it, by the team that built it.

The things that are not in the plan — new features, new integrations — are quoted as fixed-price projects, so you always choose.

Runs: parents book and pay without a member of staff in the loop. Registers and schedules are live for every venue. Two scheduled jobs keep the data tidy overnight.
